cards.title: The rise of totalitarian regime
body: The aggressive policy of Germany ,Italy and japan which eventually led to the:
Annexation of Austria (1938), invasion of Czechoslovakia (1939), and in in 1939 Poland by Germany under Adolf Hitler.
The invasion of Ethiopia by Italy under Mussolini
Also the military state of japan invaded Chinese territory of Manchuria in 1939 and invade invaded Beijing and Nanjing in 1936.
Dissatisfaction with the Versailles treaty ; both Germany and Italy didn’t accept the Versailles treaty that’s why
Hitler renounced the treaty and sent troops to the DMZ Rhine land in 1936 and increased army force and built air force the Luftwaffe.
Italy also wanted more lands and started colonial move in Africa.

The policy of appeasement : Britain and France didn’t responded to Hitler action they rather followed appeasement policy a belief that if Hitler got what he demands there could be peace( At Munich conference in 1938 Britain and France decided to give Hitler the Sudeten land of Czechoslovakia) and security which turned to the opposite.

Alliance system: Germany and Italy signed the Rome-berlin axis to help FRASISCO FRANCO in Spain in 1936 and later Germany signed the anti-comintern pact with japan .After invading Poland Germany signed the non-aggression pact with USSR in 1939.

cards.title: The immediate cause of WW2
body: Hitler’s invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939.

cards.title: The course of the war
body: Even though Britain and France declared war on Germany on September 3, 1939, war did not begin automatically. Until April 1940, there was almost no war in Europe. That is why WWII was
Called a “phony war” at the beginning.
The war continued with fast military invasion of Denmark, Norway, Netherlands, Belgium & France one after another one by one in 1940.

The German forces attacked France troops by the Luxemburg and the Ardennes Forest (a forest found in Southeastern Belgium). 380,000 British forces who meant to help the French army trapped in DUNKRIK and successfully evacuated with the help of the British navy and Belgian civilians on April 1940.

With the help of Mussolini Hitler occupied France on June 22 1940 and replaced a Nazi leadership in France (known as Vichy France and was led by an aged French hero of the First World War named Marshal Petain.

The USA followed the policy of isolationism, though British asked for help US citizens don’t want their country to interfere. But US sent its military and logistic aid through its lend-lease act starting from 1941.
Hitler at first wasn’t sure to attack Britain or the USSR but decide to attack Britain first on august 1940 he launched air strike on Britain using the Luftwaffe.

The British retaliated in kind and bombed German cities, even though German air force attacked civilian cities British army couldn’t be easily defeated Hitler postponed British attack and decided to attack USSR by the operation of Barbosa.

Despite their initial success, a severe winter and strong Soviet resistance stopped the Germans. In December 1941, the Soviets carried out a successful counterattack, and thereby Germany’s plan collapsed.
On December 7, 1941, Japanese airplanes attacked US naval base at Pearl Harbor in the Hawaiian Islands which pulled the entry of USA to the war on the side of allies.
The United States declared war on Japan the next day. Three days later, Hitler declared war on the United States.

The entry of the United States into the war changed the balance of power between the Allied and Axis powers. Great Britain, the United States, and Soviet Union formed a coalition known as the Grand Alliance.

Until late 1942, Germany had the upper hand in the war. Its forces in North Africa, led by the famous general Erwin Rommel, were able to break through British defenses in Egypt and advanced toward Alexandria, but with us entry the war shifted to the favor of the allies.

cards.title: The defeat of Germany (European Theatre)
body: In North Africa, British forces stopped the advancing German troops at El Alamein in the summer of 1942.
In November 1942, British and American forces invaded French colonies in North Africa and forced German and Italian troops to surrender in May 1943.
The Germans were forced to surrender at Stalingrad and the entire sixth Germany army were encircled and completely smashed by the USSR troops on 2 February 1943.

Besides the war the Nazi Germany had done some atrocities towards other so called inferior races. By building concentration camps or simply shoot them down.one good example was the HOLOCAST were about six million Jews were exterminated in different camps. The largest and most infamous of the camps was Auschwitz.

Since 1943, the Allies had been planning to invade German occupied France from Britain across the English Channel. The Allies managed to trick the Germans into believing that the invasion would come on the flat plains of northern France. Instead, Allied forces under US General Dwight Eisenhower landed on the Normandy beaches on June 6, 1944. The invasion of Normandy, also known as D-Day invasion, is considered to be the largest naval invasion in history.

The Germans used newly developed tanks in their offensive. But, they were severely defeated by the Soviets at the Battle of Kursk, fought between 5 and 12 July 1943.The Battle of Kursk was the greatest tank battle of WWII.
Hitler committed suicide on April 30, two days after Mussolini was shot by Italian resistance fighters. On May 7, 1945, Germany surrendered and WWII was finally over in Europe.

cards.title: II. Asian Theatre
body: Even though the war ended in Europe it continued in Asia specially japan military state air force was difficult to defat.it had pilots who were ready to sacrifice themselves at war they were known as the kamikaze or divine wind.

Us president H.S.Truman decided to use chemical nuclear bombs on japan on August 1945 on HIROSHIMA and three days later in NAGASAKI. These incident made japan to surrender. And WW2 officially ended with victory of allies.

cards.title: Consequences of the war
body: PoliticalConsequences: The war had many political consequences, among which were the following:
Germany, Italy and Japan were completely defeated and their totalitarian regimes were overthrown
The war weakened the economic, political and military power of Germany, Japan, Britain and France. In their place, the United States and the Soviet Union emerged as world superpowers.
The occupation of Eastern Europe by the USSR during the war led to the spread of communism in Europe.
The war led to the division of Germany into Soviet controlled East and US controlled West Germany

Rivalries among the wartime Allies emerged soon after the end of the war. These rivalries were characterized by economic, political, military and ideological struggles between the communist bloc led by the Soviet Union and the Western bloc led by the U.S.A.
The war resulted in the foundation of the United Nations Organization in 1945 to promote peace, security and international co-operation
The war also contributed to the process of decolonization in Africa and Asia by weakening the ability of European colonial powers to continue to hold onto their colonies.

cards.title: Economical consequence
body: It led to the destruction of European economy also japan except North American .it also showed some scientific developments but the studies result in horrific nuclear weapons and killing machines.

cards.title: Social consequence
body: About 50 million army and civilian died and over 22 million became homeless.
Another important social consequence of WWII was the increased participation of women in economic and military sectors.
